authorization.authority: root project owner acting as designated orchestrator
authorization.scope: Authorize one separate additive successor accepted-cohort manifest for the exact committed candidate only.

native_provider_evidence.disclosure: Native provider message, event, prompt, and timestamp fields are unavailable; no IDs, timestamps, or substitute provider receipts are fabricated.

disclosures: This acceptance binds every disclosure, excluded use, revocation rule, and browser-unknown limitation in the exact T5 candidate.

revocation.on_any_bound_input_drift: The successor manifest is non-consumable until regenerated and reverified.
